verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents human-readable model catalog pages: a models overview, a compare table with context windows and supported endpoints, and a deprecations page. Nothing shows a documented API endpoint an agent can call to list the live model catalog. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable spec corroborates such an endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented models endpoint
